ai.seo_question: What is the health benefit of eating kabab according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*’s chapter on dietary practices, this hadith highlights the Prophetic tradition of using specific foods for therapeutic purposes, reflecting the Imams' holistic approach to health. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that culinary habits are not merely cultural but possess intrinsic medicinal properties, aligning with the broader Islamic emphasis on preventive care and bodily well-being.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Shamy, from Husayn Bin hanzala, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said: ‘
Eat the Kabab (roast), it does away with (removes) the fever’.
